edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the sender of the public transfer entrypoint.
msg.sender is the spender authorizing the transferFrom allowance deduction.
msg.sender owns the allowance being created in approve.
manualswap authorizes only the caller equal to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes only the caller equal to _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
transfer delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve calls _approve to persist the allowance.
_transfer finalizes with _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard computes amounts via _getValues.
_getValues derives token values via _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values via _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate via _getRate.
_getRate reads supplies via _getCurrentSupply.
_transfer triggers an external router swap through swapTokensForEth before state finalization paths.
_transfer pushes ETH out to fee wallets through sendETHToFee during transfer execution.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH payout to fee wallets.
manualswap invokes the external swap routine.
manualsend invokes the ETH payout routine.

openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
